info.title: Nimpat One API
info.description:
Central REST API for Nimpat One — Nimpat Group of Companies, Nigeria.

**Money** is always an integer in minor units (kobo): `150000` = ₦1,500.00.
**Auth**: send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Refresh with `/auth/refresh`.
**Idempotency**: checkout, booking and payment-initialisation endpoints accept an `Idempotency-Key` header.
**Payments** run in Paystack test mode only.

phone.description: Nigerian mobile number in E.164 format

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token returned by login/refresh

password.description: The account password, to confirm it is really the owner

unitPriceMinor.description: Price in kobo. Null or left out means not published; it is never zero for that.

compareAtPriceMinor.description: Original price in kobo for strike-through display

listedAvailability.description: Availability shown when there is no live count

purchaseEnabled.description: False until staff confirm the item can really be supplied

action.description: PUBLISH confirms the products and puts them on sale, so customers can see them

approved.description: The pharmacist has checked the details and photo against the real product

purchaseEnabled.description: Current availability has been verified, so it may be bought

compareAtPriceMinor.description: Original price in kobo for strike-through display

delta.description: Signed change to quantity on hand

Allow pay on delivery in this zone (the division payment policy must allow it too)

division.description: Division whose cart is checked out

payableId.description: Id of the order / reservation / booking being paid for

amountOption.description: BALANCE = everything still owed; DEPOSIT = only the required deposit
